events.comment: Phase 0 -> 1: the dizziness starts in the middle of the movement tutorial (tutorial is cut short).
Counters (every frame, phases 1-5)
EmberAware (0..1): how much the player NOTICES the pull. Stays 0 for EmberHiddenTime seconds of exploring, then rises smoothly in ~2-3 s: the sudden 'something is drawing me' moment.
Phase transitions
E pressed: delete EmberC from the world, present the hand-layer Ember at mid camera view. Pickup cinematic continues in 'Head Pat System'.

EmberFx (base vision-effect strength) - smooth toward a target per phase. Phase 1 fades in slowly over EmberOnsetTime; phase 2 stays dizzy the whole way (stronger when far, stronger once the pull is noticed).

EmberPull (real magnet strength). Phase 1: none. Phase 2: almost nothing at first (0.06 -> 0.12, below what the player can feel), then 0.55 once EmberAware kicks in. After EmberMaxTime seconds it slowly gets stronger so nobody wanders forever.

parameters: lerp(EmberPull, (0.06 + 0.06 * clamp(EmberPhaseT / EmberHiddenTime, 0, 1)) * (1 - EmberAware) + (0.55 + 0.3 * clamp((EmberPhaseT - EmberMaxTime) / 20, 0, 1)) * EmberAware, 1 - exp(-1.5 * TimeDelta()))

events.comment: Directional feel. EmberAlign (set by JS) = +1 when the player looks at the Ember, -1 when looking away. Effects get weaker facing it and stronger facing away; the pull is a bit stronger when facing away. The cue is subtle before EmberAware rises and clear after.
Normal hand-layer Ember faces the player (only while presented)
Dizziness on the camera (hand-layer Ember only): FOV breathing + heartbeat punch, roll with 3 layered waves, slow view drift.
Gentle view steering toward EmberC - only after EmberAware rises, and much softer than before (the player's own mouse easily overrides it).

parameters: ToDeg(atan2(sin(ToRad(EmberBearing + EmberCamOffset - CamX)), cos(ToRad(EmberBearing + EmberCamOffset - CamX)))) * (1 - exp(-0.6 * EmberPullEff * EmberAware * TimeDelta()))

events.comment: Body drift toward EmberC (phases 2-4, stops ~110px away). Hidden stage = a few px/s (unnoticeable); after EmberAware ~120 px/s max, fading near the Ember.
After collecting: give the camera back clean (FOV + roll)
Run the Three.js + audio system every frame
Viewmodel lantern on the 'hand' layer. That layer camera is pinned at the origin looking down -Z: screen right = +X, screen up = -Y, farther = more negative Z.
Sway: the lantern lags behind mouse look and bobs with the walk cycle.

parameters: 32 + LanternSwayY + clamp((EmberFear01 - 0.6) / 0.4, 0, 1) * 1.2 * cos(TimeFromStart() * 53) + abs(sin(BobPhase * 0.5)) * BobAmp * 3 + sin(TimeFromStart() * 1.4) * 1.5 + LandDip * 0.8

events.comment: Ember sits inside the lantern glass, bobbing gently (and shivering with Fear), and always turns to face the player: the hand-layer camera is at the origin, so his yaw is 180 + the angle toward it.
Strength drains at DrainPerSecond. Within a Fireplace's WarmthRadius it recharges instead: 25% of the fire's RechargePerSecond at the edge of the radius, 100% right at the fire.
HUD bar mirrors Strength.

Ember's Fear (0..MaxFear). Each frame a target is built from what scares him: the nearest Zombie (up to +70, from 1200px away to 200px) and a fading light (up to +30 below 40% Strength). Being near a Fireplace lowers the target. Fear climbs toward the target at FearRisePerSecond and settles at FearCalmPerSecond (twice as fast by a fire). A Zombie first coming within 500px adds an instant +15 spike (re-armed once it is back beyond 800px).
Stages: 0 Calm, 1 Uneasy (30%+), 2 Afraid (60%+), 3 Terrified (85%+).
HUD bar mirrors Fear.
Flame flicker: layered sines + smoothed noise + occasional gutter dips.
